time_coverage.caveat: Time occupancy only; wrong text while a caption is present is scored by CER, not this rate

vse-80.matched_text_cer_caveat: Excludes omissions, extra events and duplicates; only a diagnostic, not total extraction accuracy
vse-80.matching_method: monotonic DP; temporal overlap >=80ms; maximize cardinality then IoU; text-independent
vse-80.metric_caveats: event_recall counts temporal matches, not correct text; unmatched outputs are not necessarily background false positives; split/merge flags require review
vse-80.text_normalization: NFKC, remove whitespace and Unicode punctuation (NOT Android comparisonKey)
